# discord_role_member_counts (Data Source)

Reads how many members have each role of a server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_role" "moderators" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Moderators"
}

data "discord_role_member_counts" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "moderator_count" {
  value = lookup(data.discord_role_member_counts.all.counts, data.discord_role.moderators.id, 0)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `counts` (Map of Number) Number of members with each role, keyed by role ID. Excludes @everyone.
